references.text: Moses calls Israel to hear the statutes and laws, the same appeal as in 4:1
Command to keep the commandments in order to live well and take possession of the land, the same theme of obedience and blessing
Appeal to keep all the commandments in order to live and take possession of the land that the Lord promised to the fathers
The choice between life and death through obedience to the Lord's commands, the same connection between obedience and life
Whoever keeps the Lord's statutes and laws shall live by them
Ezekiel quotes the promise that whoever keeps God's statutes shall live by them
Obedience to the commandments leads to the people being able to take possession of the land and live there for a long time
The Lord gives the land that he swore to give to the fathers, the same promise concerning the inheritance
Paul quotes the principle that whoever does the works of the law shall live by them
Paul refers to the principle of living by doing the commandments of the law
